newsitem.title: USA: Cezanne exhibit gives Philadelphia $87 mln boost.
newsitem.headline: Cezanne exhibit gives Philadelphia $87 mln boost.

text.p: Record attendance levels generated by a three-month Cezanne exhibit at the Philadelphia Museum of Art injected an estimated $87 million into the local economy, the museum said Thursday.
"An unprecedented critical and popular success, the Cezanne exhibition has also proven to be a remarkable fiscal boon for Philadelphia," the museum said in a statement detailing the estimate.
The Cezanne exhibit attracted a record-breaking 548,741 visitors to the exhibition during its nearly 14-week run, which ended Sept 1.

The Philadelphia Museum of Art was the only North American site for the Cezanne exhibition, which included 112 paintings and some 70 watercolors and drawings representing every stage of the artist's career.
The $86.5 million economic impact of the Cezanne exhibition is an estimate suggested by a survey of more than 1,100 of the exhibition's attendees, the museum said.
Each individual from outside Philadelphia county who came to see Cezanne spent, on average, a total of $402 during their stay, according to the survey.
